problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments into identical cargo bays. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 54 units
* Shipment Beta: mass 43 units
* Shipment Gamma: mass 34 units
* Shipment Delta: mass 69 units
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 53 units
* Shipment Zeta: mass 55 units
* Shipment Eta: mass 39 units
* Shipment Theta: mass 56 units
* Shipment Iota: mass 64 units
* Shipment Kappa: mass 61 units
* Shipment Lambda: mass 36 units
* Shipment Mu: mass 46 units
* Shipment Nu: mass 57 units
* Shipment Xi: mass 52 units
* Shipment Omicron: mass 53 units
* Shipment Pi: mass 55 units
* Shipment Rho: mass 52 units
* Shipment Sigma: mass 56 units
* Shipment Tau: mass 46 units
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 30 units
* Shipment Phi: mass 43 units
* Shipment Chi: mass 59 units
* Shipment Psi: mass 53 units
* Shipment Omega: mass 43 units
* Shipment Ares: mass 35 units
* Shipment Boreas: mass 50 units
* Shipment Cronus: mass 30 units
* Shipment Dionysus: mass 54 units
* Shipment Eos: mass 56 units
* Shipment Fates: mass 43 units
* Shipment Gaia: mass 67 units
* Shipment Helios: mass 57 units
* Shipment Iris: mass 45 units
* Shipment Janus: mass 70 units
* Shipment Krios: mass 56 units
* Shipment Leto: mass 50 units
* Shipment Metis: mass 37 units

Each cargo bay can support a maximum load of 100 units. The objective is to assign every shipment to exactly one bay such that the total mass in any bay does not surpass its capacity, while minimizing the total number of bays utilized.
